title: W7900 PARO INT8 KV external-format fast screen and transfer

candidates.name: hadamard_group32
candidates.representation: normalized Hadamard rotation plus symmetric group32 INT8

candidates.name: kivi_int8
candidates.representation: 128-token affine K-per-channel chunks, V per token/group32, incomplete BF16 tail

decision.summary: Hadamard group32 materially improves the fast screen and passes 4K/16 top-1, but its 0.15512 mean KL is 3.10x the allowed threshold. Reject native implementation and stop before 128K or task benchmarks.
decision.next_representation_candidate: AQUA-style cross-layer residual prediction if INT8 quality work continues
